question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Consensus Q3 2026 EPS ~$1.96-2.03, consistent with guidance OI $22.5-26.5B, ~19% tax, ~10.9B diluted shares, no non-operating gains. Amazon typically beats the top of its OI guide, so the ex-gain center is ~$2.05-2.15. The big swing factor: GAAP EPS includes Anthropic mark-ups recognized when Anthropic prices new shares (Q1 $2.78, Q2 $5.75 with $53.4B other income after the May $965B Series H). No primary Anthropic round in Jul-Sep 2026 was found; secondary trades and IPO talk do not trigger gains under the measurement alternative. So ~10% is priced above $2.995 for an unfound observable transaction or other large gain, and ~3% below $0.995 for a large charge or investment loss. Polymarket has a GAAP EPS beat market (~$1.2k volume, 52% Yes, opened Oct 16) that is too thin and not the same contract; no Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.

- Amazon Q2 2026 release (SEC 8-K, Jul 30, 2026): op income $27.5B (+43% y/y); net income $62.6B, $5.75/diluted share; includes $53.4B non-operating pre-tax other income mainly from Anthropic; diluted shares 10,903M.
- Q1 2026 (same 8-K): net income $30.255B, EPS $2.78 (Anthropic Series G, Feb 2026, ~$380B valuation).
- Q3 2025 EPS $1.95 (included ~$9.5B Anthropic gain plus FTC $2.5B and severance charges); Q2 2025 EPS $1.68.
- Q3 2026 guidance: net sales $197-202B; operating income $22.5-26.5B. Prime Day moved to June 2026, which hurts Q3 sales growth by ~400bp.
- Consensus Q3 2026 EPS (Oct 2026): TipRanks $1.96; Nasdaq $2.03; Barchart/Yahoo $2.02; ChartMill $2.00. Q2 2026 consensus was $1.82 vs $5.75 actual.
- Anthropic: Series H $65B at $965B post-money in May 2026 (Q2). Secondary trades ~$1.0-1.15T in Sept 2026 (thin, not a primary round). Reuters (Sept 2026) reported an IPO target above $2T; IPO not completed by Sep 30 per searches. An employee tender ran Feb-Apr 2026 at ~$350B and was undersubscribed. The $852B August tender was OpenAI's, not Anthropic's.
- Accounting: Amazon's Anthropic preferred stock gains are recognized on observable priced transactions. Searched for a Q3 (Jul-Sep) Anthropic primary round or similar-security transaction: none found.
- Amazon historically lands at or above the top of its OI guide (e.g., Q2 2025: guide $13-17.5B, actual $19.2B).
- AWS grew 37% in Q2 2026; 2026 capex raised to $220B (depreciation headwind already in guidance). Morgan Stanley raised its target to $350 (Oct 2026).
- Math: each ~$1B of after-tax net income ≈ $0.09 EPS; an Anthropic re-mark of ~+25% would add roughly $1.5+ EPS.
- Searched but not found: any Amazon pre-announcement, legal or FTC charge in Q3 2026, or a disclosed Q3 Anthropic transaction.

- Resolves off Amazon's Q3 2026 earnings release / 8-K GAAP diluted EPS (expected Oct 29, 2026), not adjusted or consensus figures.

calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) whether an observable-price Anthropic transaction occurred in Q3 — all three runs independently searched and found none (AMD $5B is milestone-based future, IPO not priced by Sep 30, secondaries don't trigger measurement-alternative gains); cannot be verified further without web access, so it carries an 11% upper-escape probability, between Run 3's 9% and Run 2's 15% on the evidence that searches were thorough but non-exhaustive. (2) OpenAI stake — tender flat at $852B, $1.4T round not closed, so no Q3 gain. Judgment: core center — Run 1's 2.12 assumes a strong OI beat; Run 3's 2.03 weights Prime-Day drag and higher tax. I take OI ~27-28B, tax ~20%, 10.9B shares → ~2.06 median. Lower escape at 2% (no identified charge mechanism). Reference class and dispersion approach similar to Run 2's; width set ~0.5 between Runs 2 and 3 based on op-income and other-income variance.
